name: security-first
description: Security best practices for all code

rules.description: Never use user input in shell commands without validation
rules.pattern: Never interpolate unsanitized user input into shell commands. Use array form or escape properly.

rules.description: Use parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection
rules.pattern: Always use parameterized queries for database operations.

rules.description: Validate all external inputs at system boundaries
rules.pattern: Validate inputs at the system boundary, not deep in the code.
